cursor-agent.description: Cursor publishes no release feed; its install script names the current build

customManagers.description: Versions recorded under a `# renovate: datasource=… depName=…` comment: shell and Dockerfile assignments (`NAME=v`, `ARG NAME=v`, `NAME="${NAME:-v}"`), workflow env values, and image refs with a digest
CNPG operator image: the kustomize override and OPERATOR_IMAGE_NAME move together (the kustomize manager cannot read a separate digest field)
External Secrets chart version of the vendored eso.yaml render
P-Stack plugin tree pinned to a cursor/plugins commit

packageRules.description: Our own images: deploy/deployer pins each to a per-commit build
Third-party images: keep tag+digest pins current
Downloaded build tools: grouped, reviewed by hand. Bump the sha256 recorded next to each version in the same PR
Agent CLIs recorded in Dockerfiles/install scripts: weekly, non-major automerge once a release is 3 days old
opencode-ai beta channel stays on beta prereleases
t3 follows its nightly channel, which runs ahead of the latest dist-tag
Cursor agent builds are dated: compare on the date, not the commit suffix
CNPG operator: the image, OPERATOR_IMAGE_NAME and the vendored CRDs/RBAC must move together
prBodyNotes: Re-vendor `deploy/cnpg/base/upstream.yaml` from this release's `cnpg-<version>.yaml` in this PR, and update the version in `deploy/cnpg/README.md` and `docs/rebuild-runbook.md` (deploy/cnpg/README.md, Upgrade).

packageRules.description: Postgres operand: images/pg-textsearch is built against this exact image
prBodyNotes: `images/pg-textsearch` must build against the same operand as `deploy/postgres/base/cluster-image-catalog.yaml`. After merge, re-pin the rebuilt pg-textsearch digest in `deploy/postgres/base/cluster.yaml`.

packageRules.description: External Secrets: eso.yaml is a vendored chart render
prBodyNotes: Re-render `deploy/eso/base/eso.yaml` from this chart version in this PR (deploy/eso/README.md, Upgrade), and update `docs/rebuild-runbook.md`.

packageRules.description: Tailscale: the operator chart is helm-installed by hand; tailscaled is installed by bootstrap
prBodyNotes: Chart and operator/proxy image versions move together: update `deploy/tailscale/values.yaml`, `deploy/tailscale/README.md` and `docs/rebuild-runbook.md`, then re-run the helm upgrade. A tailscaled bump also needs the new installer sha256 in `bootstrap/bootstrap.sh`.

packageRules.description: k3s: nodes upgrade by re-running bootstrap
prBodyNotes: Update `K3S_INSTALLER_SHA256` in `bootstrap/bootstrap.sh`, the version table in `docs/rebuild-runbook.md`, and the kind node image in `.github/workflows/ci.yaml` and `scripts/manifest-smoke.sh`.

packageRules.description: policy-controller chart is helm-installed by hand
prBodyNotes: Update `docs/rebuild-runbook.md` and `deploy/image-policy/README.md`, then re-run the helm upgrade.
